theme_strategy.mode: Dark-first (Critical for long-session tabletop play to reduce eye strain)
theme_strategy.archetype: Tactical Grimoire (Archetype 5: Luxury meets Archetype 2: Tactical)
theme_strategy.vibe: Cinematic, moody, highly legible command-center for Dungeon Masters and Players.

headings.usage: Campaign titles, Character Names, Page Headers. Gives a subtle arcane/mystical book feel.

body_ui.usage: General UI text, descriptions, lists, tooltips. Clean, modern, highly readable.

stats_and_data.usage: HP, Initiative, AC, Dice results, modifiers. Creates a 'tactical command' aesthetic.

accent.description: Ember Flame - represents action, fire, and critical hits.

rules: No pure black. Use the blue-tinted obsidian base.
Accent color (#FF4500) should be used sparsely for CTAs, active states, and dice roll highlights.
Use white/10 or white/5 for subtle dividers instead of heavy borders.

surfaces: Dashboard Cards: Flat solid backgrounds (#12121A) with 1px solid border (#272732). No soft drop shadows.
Floating UI (Dice Roller, Context Menus): Crystal Glassmorphism. bg-[#0A0A0E]/80 with backdrop-blur-xl and border border-white/10.
Active States: Use 'Tracing Beam' or subtle inner glow (box-shadow: inset 0 0 10px rgba(255, 69, 0, 0.2)) for active character turn or selected spells.
textures: Subtle noise overlay (opacity 2-3%) on the main background to break the digital flatness and give a slight 'parchment/table' feel without being cliché.

dashboard_dm.logic: Metrics and quick-actions span 3, active combat tracker spans 6, dice log spans 3.

character_sheet.classes: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-8 lg:grid-cols-12 gap-6 p-6
character_sheet.logic: Hero (Avatar + Core Stats): col-span-full lg:col-span-4 row-span-2. Attributes: col-span-4. Skills/Inventory: col-span-4 row-span-2.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing (p-6, p-8) for campaigns list. Tight Spacing (p-3, p-4) for combat tracker and inventory to maximize screen real estate during play.
grids_and_layouts.alignment_rules: All stats and tabular data must be left-aligned or tabular-aligned. Roll buttons should be vertically centered with the stat they correspond to.

components_strategy.buttons: Sharp edges (rounded-sm) or angled cuts. Primary buttons use Ember Flame background with dark text. Secondary buttons use transparent background with border-white/20 and hover:bg-white/5.
components_strategy.inputs: Shadcn UI Input, customized to bg-[#12121A], border-white/10, focus-visible:ring-1 focus-visible:ring-[#FF4500].
components_strategy.tables: Dense. border-b border-white/5. Hover state on rows: bg-white/5. JetBrains Mono for numeric columns.
components_strategy.cards: Avoid standard generic cards. Use 'border-collapse' grid styles or 1px border (#272732) with no border-radius (rounded-none or rounded-sm) for a tactical feel.
components_strategy.dice_log: A fixed or sticky glassmorphism sidebar/bottom-bar. New rolls animate in from the bottom.
components_strategy.tabs: Shadcn Tabs, customized. Active tab gets a bottom border of #FF4500 and text-white. Inactive text-gray-500.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: -translate-y-[1px] with border color shift for interactive cards. Explicit text color changes on hover.
motion_and_interactions.dice_rolls: Framer Motion for real-time feed. Staggered entrance animations. Critical Hits (20) pulse with Ember Flame glow.
motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Fade and slight slide-up (10px) using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interactions.accessibility: Respect prefers-reduced-motion. High contrast on focus rings.

campaign_backgrounds.description: Skull and papers on dark desk

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure all text against dark surfaces meets minimum 4.5:1 ratio. Muted text must be at least #9CA3AF against #12121A.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., 'roll-initiative-btn', 'add-spell-btn', 'hp-input').

instructions_to_main_agent: Follow the theme strictly. Do not deviate to light mode or generic blue SaaS colors. Keep it dark and tactical.
Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for a sharp, detailed look. DO NOT use emojis.
Do not use generic HTML inputs for complex UI. Use Shadcn for dropdowns, tabs, dialogs.
For the dice roller, implement a visual 'feed' using sonner or a custom Framer Motion list.
Implement the 'Bento Grid' strategy for the Character Sheet. Avoid standard 1-column mobile layouts if you can fit 2 dense columns.
CRITICAL: Do not use complete transparent backgrounds for headers or sticky elements. Use bg-[#0A0A0E]/80 backdrop-blur-xl.
When building the combat tracker, use dense lists. Do not waste vertical space.
Import fonts in CSS or layout: @import url('https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:wght@600;700&family=JetBrains+Mono:wght@400;700&family=Outfit:wght@300;400;500&display=swap');
Ensure the application uses .js and .jsx files, not .tsx. Adjust Shadcn imports and definitions accordingly.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Do not center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; } is FORBIDDEN).
Do not apply universal transition (transition: all). Target specific properties like transition-colors, transition-transform.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy and surface colors.
Never use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, explicit text color changes, and focus states.
Missing categories (especially sponsor logos/avatars) = use provided images. DO NOT use placeholder text.
